referenced_promises.body: estimateDelivery({ shippedOn, businessDays, holidays = [] }) returns { days, businessDays, deliveryDate }. shippedOn and deliveryDate are strict YYYY-MM-DD UTC calendar dates. Counting starts AFTER shippedOn: businessDays counts Monday-Friday dates excluding explicit holiday dates, and days is elapsed calendar days between shippedOn and deliveryDate. businessDays = 0 returns the shippedOn date with days = 0 even on a weekend or holiday. The function is pure and throws on invalid dates or negative/fractional businessDays.
referenced_promises.conditions: Valid four-digit ISO calendar dates and nonnegative safe integer businessDays; holiday entries use the same strict UTC calendar-date format. No locale, machine timezone, or implicit holiday calendar affects results.
